info.title: Purser Control Plane API
info.description:
Management API for the Purser distributed LLM inference orchestrator.

Base path: /api/v1

Authentication: Optional OIDC Bearer token. When PURSER_OIDC_ISSUER is set,
every request must carry a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
Without that environment variable the server accepts unauthenticated requests.

Enterprise endpoints (under /api/v1/enterprise/) require a valid
PURSER_LICENSE_KEY whose offline-verified payload includes the requested
feature. Without a valid entitlement they return 402 Payment Required.
The license is verified entirely offline — no phone-home.

get.description: Returns metadata for all API keys. The plaintext key and its SHA-256 hash are never returned — they are excluded by the json:"-" tag on KeyHash. The "apikeys" array is always present (never null).

200.description: API key list.

post.description: Generates a cryptographically random key formatted as "sk-" followed by 40 lowercase hex characters (20 random bytes). The plaintext key is returned exactly once in the response — only its SHA-256 hash is persisted. Copy the key immediately; it cannot be retrieved again.

201.description: Key created. Contains the plaintext key (one-time only).

post.summary: Mint a new gateway API key

get.description:
Returns the most recent audit-log entries with an end-to-end hash-chain verification result. Requires a valid license with the "audit" feature; returns 402 without one.
The returned entries are in ascending seq order. The "chain" object reports whether the hash chain is intact over the returned window. A broken chain (verified:false) is reported as a normal 200 response with a "break" object identifying the first inconsistency — it is never a 500.
Rows written before the hash chain existed (seq == 0) are skipped; they cannot spuriously fail verification.

parameters.description: Maximum number of most-recent entries to return. Defaults to 100. Verification is sound over the returned window when it covers the chain from genesis (the default for logs within the limit).
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Audit log with chain verification result.

402.description: Valid enterprise license with "audit" feature required.

get.description:
Reports whether the running instance is the community edition or a licensed enterprise installation. The verdict comes entirely from the offline-verified license key loaded at startup — no network call is made.
Always returns 200; the response body discriminates community vs. enterprise via the "edition" field.

200.description: Edition report. "edition" is "community" or "enterprise".
Successful response. Body schema is not yet specified in the contract.

get.description:
Streams live cluster metrics as Server-Sent Events. Emits an initial snapshot immediately, then one event every MetricsInterval (default 2s), until the client disconnects.
Each event is a "data: {JSON}" SSE line followed by a blank line. When a MetricsSource is configured, its Snapshot() output is emitted. Otherwise the server derives a node-state summary from the registry: {"total_nodes": N, "by_state": {"NODE_STATE_READY": K, ...}, "at": "..."}.
Keep the connection alive by reading the stream; close it to stop receiving events.

schema.description: Each SSE event line has the form: data: {JSON}\n\n The JSON payload is either a MetricsSource snapshot or the registry-derived summary (see description).

200.description: SSE stream of JSON metric snapshots.

get.description: Returns all models in the catalog. When a Planner is configured, each model is annotated with a "fit" verdict (deployable/infeasible) computed against the current fleet, so the UI can render a badge without a second round-trip. When no Planner is configured, "fit" is absent.

200.description: Model list (with optional fit annotation).

post.description: Accepts a protojson-encoded purserv1.ModelSpec. The model_id field (serialised as "modelId") is required. Promoted columns (family, architecture, params_total_b, engine) are extracted from the spec. The spec is re-marshalled via protojson before storage so it round-trips losslessly. Duplicate model_id returns 409.

400.description: Empty body, invalid protojson, or missing model_id.

409.description: A model with this ID already exists.

delete.description:
Guarded delete — never a cascade: 1. An unknown ID returns 404. 2. If any non-terminal deployment still references the model, the request
   is refused with 409 model_in_use listing the blocking deployment IDs.
   Tear those deployments down explicitly first.
3. On success, 204 No Content is returned.

409.description: Model is pinned by active deployments.

delete.summary: Remove a model from the catalog

200.description: The model.

post.description:
Resolves a DeploymentPlan and hands it to the orchestrator.
Plan resolution order: 1. Inline "plan" (protojson DeploymentPlan) in the body — caller-supplied. 2. Stored plan referenced by "plan_id". 3. Omit body entirely — the server generates a plan from the current fleet
   (requires a Planner; the generated plan is persisted to the plans table).

Returns 422 when auto-planning is used but the model does not fit the fleet. Returns 501 when no orchestrator (Deployer) is configured. Returns 400 when no plan and no plan_id are provided and no Planner is configured.

202.description: Deployment accepted. The deployment is being provisioned asynchronously.

400.description: Invalid body or no plan available.

404.description: Model or referenced plan not found.

422.description: Model does not fit the current fleet (auto-plan path only).

500.description: Orchestrator error (may include a partial deployment_id).

post.summary: Deploy a model

200.description: Successful response. Body schema is not yet specified in the contract.

post.description:
Computes the planner's layer-split plan for the model against the CURRENT fleet and returns it WITHOUT persisting anything and WITHOUT deploying. The plan is ephemeral — its ID resolves to 404 via GET /plans/{id}. No audit event is emitted.
The feasibility verdict shapes the body, not the HTTP status code: - 200 + feasible:true — the model fits; the plan is inline. - 200 + feasible:false + reason — the model does not fit; this is a
  normal outcome, not a failure (never a 4xx).

Returns 404 for an unknown model, 501 when no Planner is configured.

requestBody.description: No body required.

200.description: Preview result. Either feasible (with inline plan) or infeasible (with reason). Discriminated by the "feasible" field.

post.summary: Dry-run plan preview (read-only, no side effects)

get.description: Returns every node known to the registry, regardless of lifecycle state. The "nodes" array is always present (never null) — it is empty when no nodes are enrolled.

200.description: Node list.

delete.description:
Transitions the node to DECOMMISSIONED and revokes its certificates. This is a lifecycle transition, not a row deletion — the node remains visible in GET /nodes with state NODE_STATE_DECOMMISSIONED.
The delete is guarded: 1. An unknown ID returns 404. 2. If any non-terminal deployment still occupies the node (host or
   engine), the request is refused with 409 node_in_use; tear those
   deployments down first.
3. On success, 204 No Content is returned.
Returns 501 when no fleet manager is configured.

409.description: Node is still occupied by active deployments.

200.description: The node.

post.description:
Marks the node DRAINING so the planner stops scheduling new deployments onto it. Audits the fleet.node.draining event.
IMPORTANT: This cordons the node only. It does NOT live-migrate, rebalance, or fail over existing deployments on the node. Existing workloads continue running until explicitly torn down.
Returns 501 when no fleet manager is configured.

requestBody.description: No body required.

200.description: Node cordoned. Returns the new state.

post.summary: Cordon a node (mark it DRAINING)

200.description: Successful response. Body schema is not yet specified in the contract.

BearerAuth.description: OIDC-derived JWT. Required only when PURSER_OIDC_ISSUER is configured. Omit on unauthenticated deployments.

Node.description: A single enrolled machine in the fleet.

state.description: Lifecycle state. One of: NODE_STATE_ENROLLED, NODE_STATE_READY, NODE_STATE_RUNNING, NODE_STATE_DRAINING, NODE_STATE_DECOMMISSIONED.

advertised_agent_addr.description: host:port of this node's AgentService as advertised at enrollment. Empty when not advertised; callers fall back to hostname + well-known port.

advertised_inference_addr.description: host:port of the OpenAI-compatible inference API on this node. Empty when not advertised.

last_seen.description: Timestamp of the most recent heartbeat.

hardware_profile.description: Full purserv1.HardwareProfile encoded as JSON. Schema is opaque.

message.example: node cordoned (unschedulable); existing deployments are not migrated or rebalanced

spec.description: Full purserv1.ModelSpec encoded as protojson. Fields are camelCase.

Fit.description: Deployability verdict for a model against the current fleet. Present only when the server has a Planner configured.

node_count.description: Number of nodes needed for the plan.

deficit_gb.description: GB of VRAM/RAM missing when not deployable.

reason.example: insufficient VRAM across all ready nodes

example: add a node with at least 48 GB VRAM

EstimateRange.description: Estimated throughput range for a deployable model.

headroom_gb.description: Remaining VRAM/RAM headroom after the model is loaded.

CreateModelRequest.description: A protojson-encoded purserv1.ModelSpec. All field names are lowerCamelCase as per the protojson convention. The model_id field (serialised as "modelId") is required.

Plan.description: A DeploymentPlan produced by the planner and stored in the plans table.

plan.description: Full purserv1.DeploymentPlan encoded as protojson (lowerCamelCase fields). Contains assignments, pipeline_order, explanation, and other planner output.

PlanPreviewFeasible.description: Preview response when the model fits the current fleet. The plan is ephemeral and NOT persisted to the plans table — the id will resolve to 404 when fetched via GET /plans/{id}.

PlanPreviewInfeasible.description: Preview response when the model does not fit the current fleet.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation of why the model does not fit.
reason.example: insufficient VRAM across all ready nodes

Deployment.description: An instantiation of a plan for a model (possibly active).

state.description: One of: DEPLOYMENT_STATE_PLANNED, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_PROVISIONING, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_ACTIVE, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_REBALANCING, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_STOPPING, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_STOPPED, DEPLOYMENT_STATE_FAILED.

DeployRequest.description: Optional body for POST /models/{id}/deploy. Supply one of: an inline protojson DeploymentPlan in "plan", a stored plan ID in "plan_id", or omit the body entirely to let the server generate a plan from the current fleet (requires a Planner to be configured).

plan_id.description: ID of a stored plan (from GET /plans/{id}) to execute.

plan.description: Inline protojson-encoded purserv1.DeploymentPlan. Fields are lowerCamelCase. Takes priority over plan_id.

DeployResponse.description: Response body from POST /models/{id}/deploy on success.

APIKey.description: A gateway API credential. The plaintext key and its SHA-256 hash are never returned from the list endpoint — only metadata. The plaintext key is returned exactly once from the create endpoint.

CreateAPIKeyResponse.description: Response from POST /apikeys. The "key" field contains the plaintext secret ("sk-" followed by 40 lowercase hex characters). It is returned exactly once and never stored — copy it immediately.

key.description: Plaintext gateway key. Returned once; never stored or re-retrievable.

ttl_seconds.description: Token lifetime in seconds. Omit or set <= 0 to use the fleet default (1h).

JoinTokenResponse.description: A single-use, expiring cluster join token.

token.description: Opaque join token. Pass to the agent via PURSER_JOIN_TOKEN.

cluster_id.description: ID of the cluster the token grants access to.

ClusterHealth.description: Coarse cluster health summary derived from the registry.

status.description: One of: "ok" (at least one ready node), "empty" (no nodes enrolled), "degraded" (nodes exist but none are ready), "unavailable" (registry unreachable — only returned with HTTP 503).

EnterpriseStatusCommunity.description: Enterprise status response for the community edition.

EnterpriseStatusLicensed.description: Enterprise status response for a valid licensed installation.

AuditEntry.description: One entry in the tamper-evident hash chain. Seq, PrevHash and Hash are the chain fields; TimeUnixNano is the wall-clock record time as Unix nanoseconds (integer, not a date-time string, to avoid formatting ambiguity in the canonical hash computation).

time_unix_nano.description: Wall-clock time the entry was recorded, as Unix nanoseconds.

actor.description: Who performed the action (e.g. an API-key ID or "api").

target.description: ID or name of the resource affected.

details.description: Optional structured context. May be omitted or null.

prev_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 hash of the previous entry (or all-zeros for genesis).

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 chain digest of this entry.

ChainVerification.description: Result of the end-to-end hash-chain verification over the returned window.

verified.description: True when every entry's hash and chain link is intact.

length.description: Number of entries included in the verification.

break.description: Present only when verified is false. Identifies the first broken link.

index.description: 0-based index of the offending entry in the "entries" array.

seq.description: Seq value the offending entry carries.

kind.description: Failure kind. One of: "seq" (reordered/deleted), "link" (broken PrevHash), "hash" (content tampered).

msg.example: stored hash does not match recomputed hash

entries.description: Audit entries in ascending seq order.

Error.description: Standard error envelope. All non-success responses (except the enterprise license gate) use this shape.

ConflictNodeInUse.description: 409 Conflict when a node still hosts active deployments.

message.example: node still hosts one or more active deployments; tear them down or migrate them first

ConflictModelInUse.description: 409 Conflict when a model is referenced by active deployments.

message.example: model is referenced by one or more active deployments; tear them down first

ModelDoesNotFit.description: 422 Unprocessable Entity when the model cannot be placed on the current fleet.

message.example: insufficient VRAM across all ready nodes (missing 24.5 GB)

reason.example: insufficient VRAM across all ready nodes

example: add a node with at least 48 GB VRAM

LicenseRequired.description: 402 Payment Required — returned by enterprise endpoints when no valid license with the required feature is present. Note: the shape differs from the standard Error envelope — the "error" field is a nested object.

DeployError.description: 500 error from the deploy endpoint, which may include a partial deployment_id.

deployment_id.description: Present when the orchestrator partially created the deployment before failing.
